title: THE UNMADE — The Unanswered Atlas: Canon, Cast, Cities & Long-Form Mysteries
status: new editorial canon / narrative production contracts; none of the new details is a finished Unreal scene

historical_protection.sources_of_knowledge: direct witness, delivered rumor, public locally observed result, never omniscient state
historical_protection.unsettled_questions: never answer by implication or an adaptation-only 'secret truth' that overwrites player choice

continuity_lexicon.ESTABLISHED: already directly supported by existing game source or canonical text
continuity_lexicon.LITERARY_CANON: new editorial/cultural facts, approved for future adaptation but not yet UE-implemented
continuity_lexicon.IN_WORLD_CLAIM: a character's personally attributable statement, may be honestly mistaken
continuity_lexicon.DISPUTED: at least two incompatible surviving accounts; no adjudication without new authorized story decision
continuity_lexicon.OPEN: deliberately unresolved and must be preserved until explicitly commissioned
continuity_lexicon.SEALED: writer-room answer held privately if later defined; no public revelation by accident
continuity_lexicon.ADAPTATION_VARIANT: medium-specific staging that changes no causal core

cities.name: The Crossings
cities.recognition: three roads meet under one missing mile
cities.skyline: Timber footbridges tied with three competing knots; street tiles from three abandoned maps
cities.sound: A humming roadstone counterpoint to market kettles
cities.social_rule: Wards refuse to ask a traveler for a name until they have eaten
cities.personal_stakes: Orrel marks crossings with an inkless nail; Kesta can deliver testimony but cannot decide which road is right
cities.anomaly: The third road runs through an address erased from Paperhaven's publicly dated surveys
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Bellwold
cities.recognition: the bell tower whose bell was never cast
cities.skyline: Copper-green tower with an empty suspended yoke; refuge lanterns reflected in washed gray stone
cities.sound: A missing last bell note followed by the continued noise of people eating
cities.social_rule: An uncounted cup is set out even on nights when there are fewer chairs than guests
cities.personal_stakes: Hessa weighs survival against exposure of the erased census; Sorin and Ivera disagree without being enemies
cities.anomaly: Rook lights a lantern on a doorstep that only some returning travelers can locate
cities.visual_icon: empty bronze yoke with one lit refuge cup
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Paperhaven
cities.recognition: the city where evidence is physically heavier than paper
cities.skyline: Chalk vaults, narrow roof-high archives and the dry garden that never grew in rain
cities.sound: A scratch of quills that never aligns with the tower clock
cities.social_rule: Residents can correct a public record but cannot publish another person's private name without their consent
cities.personal_stakes: Sevrin's authority depends on the library surviving; Toma notices crossed-out lines survive copying
cities.anomaly: An index entry cites a volume printed before its press existed
cities.visual_icon: two dry paper leaves under a weight stone
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Saltwake
cities.recognition: the harbor which has weather but no sea
cities.skyline: Pier skeletons standing above slate flats; inverted keel roofs and immaculate tide grooves
cities.sound: Rain on hulls with no answering water slap
cities.social_rule: Leave a rope knot with dry hands before requesting refuge
cities.personal_stakes: Sella maps what others call impossible; Harrow protects lives on the dry docks but signed old ownership papers
cities.anomaly: One buoy rings before the storm instead of after, even when its rope is cut
cities.visual_icon: dry cup inside a tide circle
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Cinderhold
cities.recognition: the city whose sun rises beneath its foundations
cities.skyline: Basalt ventilator ribs, public furnace court, deep angular steps and doubled chimney shadows
cities.sound: Metal vent shutters and loaves cracking over too-even heat
cities.social_rule: The first cooled coal is given, not sold
cities.personal_stakes: Tarin knows the fire's missing beat; Rheva maintains public safety; Ovenna sees the cost borne by vulnerable households
cities.anomaly: One oven records a child's birthday in ash before that child's birth
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Drevlach
cities.recognition: the debt city where tomorrow is stamped before dawn
cities.skyline: Black-teal paper docks, dry counting bridges and silver inverted-date clocks
cities.sound: Ink nibs striking account stone as absent oars move
cities.social_rule: Read every contract in both directions; silence cannot sign
cities.personal_stakes: Veynu keeps contradictory books to protect those named in them; Orshel ferries evidence rather than people

cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Orravane
cities.recognition: the upside-down city suspended by an absent seventh note
cities.skyline: Hanging terraces, counterweighted rooms, honey-gold tuning teeth and chalk rest platforms
cities.sound: A chorus with a structurally necessary missing interval
cities.social_rule: Tap a load rail before speaking so a voice will not be mistaken for an echo
cities.personal_stakes: Yllesh protects occupied buildings; Orru argues that compulsory singing is another kind of erasure
cities.anomaly: At each seventh rest an empty platform rocks as though someone sat down
cities.visual_icon: seven rail beads with one empty socket
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Vathless
cities.recognition: the inhabited quarry of concealed names
cities.skyline: Houses and family stairways carved from load-bearing old quarry walls
cities.sound: A long chisel echo that returns with a different syllable
cities.social_rule: No bearing stone may be broken while a household sleeps above it
cities.personal_stakes: Ghraet protects structural integrity; Issil asks who has the right to read an erased ancestor aloud
cities.anomaly: The quarry's oldest seam bears a mason's mark from Drevlach's future receipt
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Eillun
cities.recognition: the city that cannot agree how many people live there
cities.skyline: Woven address signs, twin-door kitchens, unsigned lantern ways and a threshold loom
cities.sound: Paired door knocks whose second answer sometimes comes first
cities.social_rule: Ask how to find someone's home, never demand their official number
cities.personal_stakes: Nhel maintains counts to deliver food; Auvet protects those who won't be counted; Veysha fears what a census can enforce
cities.anomaly: An empty registered plot wears a threshold smooth beneath constant footsteps
cities.visual_icon: two door markers tied by one thread
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Tharniv
cities.recognition: the orchard capital with a throne nobody accepted
cities.skyline: An empty crown plinth in a grafted apple grove, petition bark and rooted voting circles
cities.sound: Autumn leaves shuffling like papers being moved across a hearing desk
cities.social_rule: Leave one piece of fruit unclaimed at a hearing
cities.personal_stakes: Serriv refuses easy legitimacy; Imro feeds people rather than theories; Eliun records appeals no throne can adjudicate
cities.anomaly: The tree growing over the plinth has older petitions than roots
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

cities.name: Auvren
cities.recognition: the threshold city whose departure steps were made before arrival
cities.skyline: Limestone rooms that imply an outside within themselves, two founding thresholds and a northern witness plateau
cities.sound: A footstep arrives before its audible contact
cities.social_rule: When asked where you are from, describe what you carry, not what blood proves
cities.personal_stakes: Orriv remembers arrivals that never happened; Veilune preserves incompatible testimony; Thae keeps exits reliably passable
cities.anomaly: The second threshold opens on a morning the city never experienced
cities.adaption_rule: Keep the city's material signature, audible identity, civic disagreement, and visible ordinary life; never make its paradox a generic fantasy portal.

transmedia_packages.name: The Cup No Census Claimed
transmedia_packages.premise: A refuge matron must preserve a family's safety when the records that could clear her of wrongdoing would expose those she promised to protect.
transmedia_packages.story_engine: Who can tell the truth when the truth becomes a map for those looking to punish someone?
transmedia_packages.ending_promise: The shelter survives with a costly compromise; the origin of its uncounted cup is not solved.

transmedia_packages.name: Rain That Has No Sea
transmedia_packages.premise: A navigator maps harbors omitted from history while a harbor warden confronts the legal disaster he once allowed.
transmedia_packages.story_engine: Each episode pairs a concrete civic repair with evidence of a different impossible transaction.
transmedia_packages.ending_promise: A fairer ferry service exists; the author of the sealed chart alteration remains unknown.

transmedia_packages.name: The Seventh Rest
transmedia_packages.premise: The city will fall if its choir stops. The singers will break if they cannot.
transmedia_packages.story_engine: An engineering and consent thriller built around the sound of something that is not being sung.
transmedia_packages.ending_promise: A hard-won scheduled rest is possible without solving the singerless platform.

transmedia_packages.name: The Roads Beyond the Witness
transmedia_packages.premise: A series of disputed public crossings links people who refuse inherited titles to places missing from maps.
transmedia_packages.story_engine: Physical investigation, earned atlas routes, guarded choices and individual resident memories.
transmedia_packages.ending_promise: A route opens, not an answer to the protagonist's origins.

rules_for_adaptation: Characters may have medium-specific dialogue but their personal motives, name, origin region and limits on knowledge remain consistent.
No series/novel/movie declares one mutually exclusive player ending the universal canonical ending; adapt with a visible variant label or set before the divergence.
A local humane victory must not claim that a cosmic villain personally perpetrated every historical injustice.
A mystery may yield a satisfying local answer while its larger pattern remains legitimately unanswered.
Distinctive icons, sound motifs, materials and gestures recur naturally; no arbitrary Easter eggs without a provenance path.
The protagonist's appearance, ancestry and chosen ethics remain free; side protagonists can carry standalone screen stories.
release_rule: Every new volume carries stable IDs, canon facts vs character claims, dated continuity update, callbacks to earlier volumes, future hooks without forced answers, and separate spoiler permissions.
